raw_prompt: !fix two things for the tnt boots. One it spawns them in the ground so +1 to it's y. Also it shouldnt spawn if im standing still
reviewer_feedback: Updated TNT Trail Boots to spawn TNT one block above the ground and only when the player is moving.
usage_instructions: Use /get-tnt-boots to receive your TNT Trail Boots.
Equip the boots and walk around to spawn TNT behind you.
TNT will not spawn if you are standing still.

traces.intent_summary: Adjust TNT spawning logic for tnt_trail_boots.sk to spawn at a higher Y-coordinate and prevent spawning while the player is stationary.

traces.rationale: Added 'if loop-player is moving' to prevent spawning while stationary. Added 'add 1 to y-coordinate of {_back}' to ensure the TNT spawns at foot level rather than inside the block below the player.
